s0001.literal: Second year of Tianli, spring, first month, on jiwei new moon, a commander-in-chief's office was established to oversee the Left and Right Qipchaq guards and the Dragon Escort Guard.
s0001.idiomatic: Second year of Tianli, spring, first month, on jiwei new moon, a commander-in-chief's office was established to oversee the Left and Right Qipchaq guards and the Dragon Escort Guard.

s0002.literal: On gengshen day, privy council administrator Huosha was enfeoffed Prince Zhaowu.
s0002.idiomatic: On gengshen day, privy council administrator Huosha was enfeoffed Prince Zhaowu.

s0003.literal: Chuangu'er's son Dali inherited his father's enfeoffment as Prince of Jurong Commandery.
s0003.idiomatic: Chuangu'er's son Dali inherited his father's enfeoffment as Prince of Jurong Commandery.

s0004.literal: The King of Koryo dispatched envoys to court to offer congratulations.
s0004.idiomatic: The King of Koryo dispatched envoys to court to offer congratulations.

s0005.literal: Former Hanlin academician-director Badashah was dispatched north to return to His Elder Brother's traveling encampment; the Grand Storehouse director Shalaban was still ordered to convey gold and silks thither.
s0005.idiomatic: Former Hanlin academician-director Badashah was dispatched north to return to His Elder Brother's traveling encampment; the Grand Storehouse director Shalaban was still ordered to convey gold and silks thither.

s0006.literal: On xinyou day, Doreli Temür was again enfeoffed Prince of Chu.
s0006.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Doreli Temür was again enfeoffed Prince of Chu.

s0007.literal: Prince of Gaochang Temür Buqa was made central secretariat left chancellor; grand minister of husbandry Wang Yi was made associate administrator and privy council administrator.
s0007.idiomatic: Prince of Gaochang Temür Buqa was made central secretariat left chancellor; grand minister of husbandry Wang Yi was made associate administrator and privy council administrator.

s0008.literal: His Elder Brother dispatched Qurighaq Dasun and Lala to the capital.
s0008.idiomatic: His Elder Brother dispatched Qurighaq Dasun and Lala to the capital.

s0009.literal: Because Bertemur had meritorious service in attendance, envoys were dispatched with one hundred bolts of silks to grant him at the traveling encampment.
s0009.idiomatic: Because Bertemur had meritorious service in attendance, envoys were dispatched with 100 bolts of silks to grant him at the traveling encampment.

s0010.literal: Prince Hun Temür died; his seal and the seal of his prince tutor were taken and granted to Woqi.
s0010.idiomatic: Prince Hun Temür died; his seal and the seal of his prince tutor were taken and granted to Woqi.

s0011.literal: Prince Wuning Chechequ dispatched envoys to report the date when His Elder Brother would set out.
s0011.idiomatic: Prince Wuning Chechequ dispatched envoys to report the date when His Elder Brother would set out.

s0012.literal: On guihai day, Yan Temür was made censor-in-chief; the Prince of Taiping remained as before.
s0012.idiomatic: On guihai day, Yan Temür was made censor-in-chief; the Prince of Taiping remained as before.

s0013.literal: The Grand Princess of Lu was granted twenty thousand ingots of notes to build a residence.
s0013.idiomatic: The Grand Princess of Lu was granted 20,000 ingots of notes to build a residence.

s0014.literal: On jiazi day, Venus encroached upon the Encampment Wall formation.
s0014.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Venus encroached upon the Encampment Wall formation.

s0015.literal: The seasonal offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0015.idiomatic: The seasonal offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0016.literal: Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür died.
s0016.idiomatic: Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür died.

s0017.literal: On yichou day, the central secretariat said: "This year's fodder expenditure is insufficient; beyond the regular disbursements, all petitioners should not be granted.
s0017.idiomatic: On yichou day, the central secretariat said: "This year's fodder expenditure is insufficient; beyond the regular disbursements, all petitioners should not be granted.

s0018.literal: " It was approved, and central secretariat right vice chancellor Cherig Temür was still ordered to take overall charge of the matter.
s0018.idiomatic: " It was approved, and central secretariat right vice chancellor Cherig Temür was still ordered to take overall charge of the matter.

s0019.literal: On bingyin day, the Emperor visited the Great Monastery of Great Blessing, Fortune, and Primordial Origin.
s0019.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the Emperor visited the Great Monastery of Great Blessing, Fortune, and Primordial Origin.

s0020.literal: Envoys were dispatched to grant the western princes Yenzhijitai two eastern sea gyrfalcons each.
s0020.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to grant the western princes Yenzhijitai 2 eastern sea gyrfalcons each.

s0021.literal: On wuchen day, envoys were dispatched to present eastern sea gyrfalcons at His Elder Brother's traveling encampment.
s0021.idiomatic: On wuchen day, envoys were dispatched to present eastern sea gyrfalcons at His Elder Brother's traveling encampment.

s0022.literal: On jisi day, inner and outer soldiers numbering forty-two thousand two hundred seventy persons were each granted one ingot of notes.
s0022.idiomatic: On jisi day, inner and outer soldiers numbering 42,270 persons were each granted 1 ingot of notes.

s0024.literal: Shaanxi reported famine; relief was granted with fifty thousand ingots of notes.
s0024.idiomatic: Shaanxi reported famine; relief was granted with 50,000 ingots of notes.

s0025.literal: On xinwei day, because of investing the empress, announcement was made at the southern suburban altar.
s0025.idiomatic: On xinwei day, because of investing the empress, announcement was made at the southern suburban altar.

s0026.literal: The Prince of Yu was granted a gold seal.
s0026.idiomatic: The Prince of Yu was granted a gold seal.

s0027.literal: Huihui households were made to share corvée duties equally with the common populace.
s0027.idiomatic: Huihui households were made to share corvée duties equally with the common populace.

s0028.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Recently when a Qipchaq household was registered and confiscated, his son being sixteen years of age, please order him to dwell with his mother;
s0028.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Recently when a Qipchaq household was registered and confiscated, his son being 16 years of age, please order him to dwell with his mother;

s0029.literal: We further request that hereafter when officials commit crimes and suffer registration and confiscation, if their wives have children, others may not petition for them, nor may they be confiscated as government household members.
s0029.idiomatic: We further request that hereafter when officials commit crimes and suffer registration and confiscation, if their wives have children, others may not petition for them, nor may they be confiscated as government household members.

s0031.literal: On renshen day, inner attendant Xingjiban was dispatched with an edict to Sichuan to summon and instruct Nangjiatai.
s0031.idiomatic: On renshen day, inner attendant Xingjiban was dispatched with an edict to Sichuan to summon and instruct Nangjiatai.

s0032.literal: On guiyou day, central secretariat and Xuanzheng Bureau officials were ordered to examine and verify the grain allowances of inner attendants and guard soldiers and fix their registers.
s0032.idiomatic: On guiyou day, central secretariat and Xuanzheng Bureau officials were ordered to examine and verify the grain allowances of inner attendants and guard soldiers and fix their registers.

s0033.literal: Because the Liaodong Branch Secretariat's thirty thousand households of Mongol, Koryo, and Zhaozhou commanders and officers had joined the rebellion and raised troops to violate the capital region, their tally seals and printed edicts were confiscated.
s0033.idiomatic: Because the Liaodong Branch Secretariat's 30,000 households of Mongol, Koryo, and Zhaozhou commanders and officers had joined the rebellion and raised troops to violate the capital region, their tally seals and printed edicts were confiscated.

s0034.literal: This year's willow grove field hunt was suspended.
s0034.idiomatic: This year's willow grove field hunt was suspended.

s0035.literal: The salt system was restored so that every four hundred jin constituted one certificate, with one certificate valued at three ingots of notes.
s0035.idiomatic: The salt system was restored so that every 400 jin constituted 1 certificate, with 1 certificate valued at 3 ingots of notes.

s0036.literal: Sichuan's Nangjiatai requested troops from Pacifier of the West Martial and Tranquil Prince Shishban; Shishban guarded the passes with troops.
s0036.idiomatic: Sichuan's Nangjiatai requested troops from Pacifier of the West Martial and Tranquil Prince Shishban; Shishban guarded the passes with troops.

s0037.literal: On jiaxu day, Grand Equerry Jiaohua was again ordered to present eastern sea gyrfalcons at His Elder Brother's traveling encampment.
s0037.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Grand Equerry Jiaohua was again ordered to present eastern sea gyrfalcons at His Elder Brother's traveling encampment.

s0038.literal: The Central Auspicious Bureau was abolished.
s0038.idiomatic: The Central Auspicious Bureau was abolished.

s0039.literal: On bingzi day, the empress's attendant ministers Zhang Zhutong and six others were appointed academicians of the Academy of Gathered Worthies and other offices.
s0039.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the empress's attendant ministers Zhang Zhutong and 6 others were appointed academicians of the Academy of Gathered Worthies and other offices.

s0040.literal: On dingchou day, Sichuan's Nangjiatai broke through Maowa Pass in Bozhou; pacification commissioner Yang Yanlibuhua opened the pass and admitted him.
s0040.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Sichuan's Nangjiatai broke through Maowa Pass in Bozhou; pacification commissioner Yang Yanlibuhua opened the pass and admitted him.

s0041.literal: Shaanxi Mongol army commander-in-chief Buqatai was Nangjiatai's younger brother; Nangjiatai dispatched envoys to summon him — Buqatai would not obey and beheaded the envoys.
s0041.idiomatic: Shaanxi Mongol army commander-in-chief Buqatai was Nangjiatai's younger brother; Nangjiatai dispatched envoys to summon him — Buqatai would not obey and beheaded the envoys.

s0042.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Court rewards and grants should not be lavishly extended to those with no merit.
s0042.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Court rewards and grants should not be lavishly extended to those with no merit.

s0043.literal: Food for hawks, gyrfalcons, lions, and leopards — formerly the meat price disbursed was more than two hundred ingots; now it has been increased to thirteen thousand eight hundred ingots;
s0043.idiomatic: Food for hawks, gyrfalcons, lions, and leopards — formerly the meat price disbursed was more than 200 ingots; now it has been increased to 13,800 ingots;

s0044.literal: the Crane Control register formerly numbered only six hundred twenty-eight households — now it has been increased by two thousand four hundred households.
s0044.idiomatic: the Crane Control register formerly numbered only 628 households — now it has been increased by 2,400 households.

s0045.literal: Moreover, annual Buddhist expenditure — comparing present with former, the increase is more than one thousand one hundred fifty taels of gold, six thousand two hundred taels of silver, fifty-six thousand two hundred ingots of notes, and more than thirty-four thousand bolts of silks;
s0045.idiomatic: Moreover, annual Buddhist expenditure — comparing present with former, the increase is more than 1,150 taels of gold, 6,200 taels of silver, 56,200 ingots of notes, and more than 34,000 bolts of silks;

s0046.literal: we request that all be selected and reduced.
s0046.idiomatic: we request that all be selected and reduced.

s0048.literal: Central Domestic Affairs Court officials said the empress's daily needs were one hundred thousand ingots of notes, fifty thousand bolts of silks, and five thousand jin of cotton.
s0048.idiomatic: Central Domestic Affairs Court officials said the empress's daily needs were 100,000 ingots of notes, 50,000 bolts of silks, and 5,000 jin of cotton.

s0049.literal: An edict granted notes to half what was needed and silks to ten thousand bolts.
s0049.idiomatic: An edict granted notes to half what was needed and silks to 10,000 bolts.

s0050.literal: Famine victims in Fangshan, Fanyang, and other counties of Zhuo Prefecture, Dadu Route, were relieved with two months' grain.
s0050.idiomatic: Famine victims in Fangshan, Fanyang, and other counties of Zhuo Prefecture, Dadu Route, were relieved with 2 months' grain.

s0051.literal: On jimao day, because of investing the empress, announcement was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0051.idiomatic: On jimao day, because of investing the empress, announcement was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0052.literal: On gengchen day, lecturers Liu Daoheng and three others of the hidden residence were granted office of seventh rank; Xue Yun and sixteen others were granted office of eighth rank.
s0052.idiomatic: On gengchen day, lecturers Liu Daoheng and 3 others of the hidden residence were granted office of 7th rank; Xue Yun and 16 others were granted office of 8th rank.

s0053.literal: On xinsi day, Shi Weiliang, former central secretariat left vice chancellor, was recalled to service as supervising censor-in-chief.
s0053.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Shi Weiliang, former central secretariat left vice chancellor, was recalled to service as supervising censor-in-chief.

s0054.literal: Shangdu officials — only those newly entering office or abruptly promoted were dismissed; the rest were permitted to resume former ranks.
s0054.idiomatic: Shangdu officials — only those newly entering office or abruptly promoted were dismissed; the rest were permitted to resume former ranks.

s0055.literal: Three hundred ingots of notes from censorate fines were granted to Jiaofang official Salir.
s0055.idiomatic: 300 ingots of notes from censorate fines were granted to Jiaofang official Salir.

s0056.literal: On renwu day, Shaanxi Branch Censorate censor-in-chief Abu Haiya was made central secretariat associate administrator.
s0056.idiomatic: On renwu day, Shaanxi Branch Censorate censor-in-chief Abu Haiya was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0057.literal: His Elder Brother dispatched attendants Boluo and Tiezhuqi to the capital first; they were rewarded with gold, silks, and residences; inner attendant Tutu Jiaohua was still dispatched to His Elder Brother's traveling encampment.
s0057.idiomatic: His Elder Brother dispatched attendants Boluo and Tiezhuqi to the capital first; they were rewarded with gold, silks, and residences; inner attendant Tutu Jiaohua was still dispatched to His Elder Brother's traveling encampment.

s0058.literal: Bozhou wanhu Yang led Sichuan rebel troops to Wujiang Peak; government troops defeated them;
s0058.idiomatic: Bozhou wanhu Yang led Sichuan rebel troops to Wujiang Peak; government troops defeated them;

s0059.literal: the Eight Fan commander-in-chief Tuochu also defeated the rebel troops on the north bank of the Wujiang River and recaptured the pass.
s0059.idiomatic: the Eight Fan commander-in-chief Tuochu also defeated the rebel troops on the north bank of the Wujiang River and recaptured the pass.

s0060.literal: Prince Yolqi Temür commanded Mongol, Han, and dalqan troops and civilian levies numbering fifty-five thousand — all reached the Wujiang.
s0060.idiomatic: Prince Yolqi Temür commanded Mongol, Han, and dalqan troops and civilian levies numbering 55,000 — all reached the Wujiang.

s0061.literal: On guiwei day, Pacifier Prince Mainu was dispatched to the traveling encampment.
s0061.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Pacifier Prince Mainu was dispatched to the traveling encampment.

s0062.literal: On bingxu day, His Elder Brother Emperor Mingzong ascended the imperial throne north of Helin.
s0062.idiomatic: On bingxu day, His Elder Brother Emperor Mingzong ascended the imperial throne north of Helin.

s0063.literal: Sichuan's Nangjiatai burned the great bridge at Jiwu Pass and also burned the plank road.
s0063.idiomatic: Sichuan's Nangjiatai burned the great bridge at Jiwu Pass and also burned the plank road.

s0064.literal: The central secretariat was ordered to record thirty-four officials of Jiangling and Bianliang prefectures and counties who had attended as escorts — all were promoted in rank.
s0064.idiomatic: The central secretariat was ordered to record 34 officials of Jiangling and Bianliang prefectures and counties who had attended as escorts — all were promoted in rank.

s0065.literal: Shaanxi suffered great famine; the branch secretariat requested three hundred thousand shi of grain and three hundred thousand ingots of notes; an edict granted one hundred forty thousand ingots of notes and dispatched envoys to distribute them.
s0065.idiomatic: Shaanxi suffered great famine; the branch secretariat requested 300,000 shi of grain and 300,000 ingots of notes; an edict granted 140,000 ingots of notes and dispatched envoys to distribute them.

s0066.literal: Datong Route reported that last year drought and warfare together afflicted the people, many of whom wandered and starved; an edict ordered that ten thousand three hundred shi of grain from the route and East Sheng Prefecture be used for relief sale at one-third below the market price.
s0066.idiomatic: Datong Route reported that last year drought and warfare together afflicted the people, many of whom wandered and starved; an edict ordered that 10,300 shi of grain from the route and East Sheng Prefecture be used for relief sale at one-third below the market price.

s0067.literal: Wang Xianzheng of Pucheng County, Fengyuan, with five generations dwelling together; Wei Hui'an's wife Chen of Weihui; Liu, wife of Wang Cheng of Hejian; Kou, wife of Li Xiaoren of Jinang; Lei, wife of Wang Yi of Puzhou; Zhang, second wife of Xi of Nanyang; and Zhai, wife of Aluhui of Huaqing — all for chaste conduct, had their gates commended.
s0067.idiomatic: Wang Xianzheng of Pucheng County, Fengyuan, with 5 generations dwelling together; Wei Hui'an's wife Chen of Weihui; Liu, wife of Wang Cheng of Hejian; Kou, wife of Li Xiaoren of Jinang; Lei, wife of Wang Yi of Puzhou; Zhang, second wife of Xi of Nanyang; and Zhai, wife of Aluhui of Huaqing — all for chaste conduct, had their gates commended.

s0068.literal: Second month, on jichou day, Nangjiatai of Sichuan was partially pardoned.
s0068.idiomatic: Second month, on jichou day, Nangjiatai of Sichuan was partially pardoned.

s0069.literal: On gengyin day, Yan Temür was again made central secretariat right chancellor.
s0069.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Yan Temür was again made central secretariat right chancellor.

s0070.literal: The Weaving Artisans Bureau was established to manage weaving imperial patterned silks; rank 3a.
s0070.idiomatic: The Weaving Artisans Bureau was established to manage weaving imperial patterned silks; rank 3a.

s0071.literal: On xinmao day, the Emperor presided in Daming Hall and invested Empress Onggirad.
s0071.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor presided in Daming Hall and invested Empress Onggirad.

s0072.literal: Huang Keshun, military-civilian commander-general of Sien Prefecture, Guangxi, came to present tribute goods.
s0072.idiomatic: Huang Keshun, military-civilian commander-general of Sien Prefecture, Guangxi, came to present tribute goods.

s0073.literal: On renchen day, Nangjiatai held Jiwu Pass and seized the Sancha, Chaiguan, and other relay stations.
s0073.idiomatic: On renchen day, Nangjiatai held Jiwu Pass and seized the Sancha, Chaiguan, and other relay stations.

s0074.literal: On guisi day, Hanlin attendant lecturer academician Cao Yuanyong was dispatched to sacrifice to Confucius at Que li.
s0074.idiomatic: On guisi day, Hanlin attendant lecturer academician Cao Yuanyong was dispatched to sacrifice to Confucius at Que li.

s0075.literal: Nangjiatai sent a letter to entice Gongchang commander-in-chief Wang Yanchang.
s0075.idiomatic: Nangjiatai sent a letter to entice Gongchang commander-in-chief Wang Yanchang.

s0076.literal: On bingshen day, central secretariat and Hanlin National History Academy officials were ordered to sacrifice to the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong at Puji Temple.
s0076.idiomatic: On bingshen day, central secretariat and Hanlin National History Academy officials were ordered to sacrifice to the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong at Puji Temple.

s0077.literal: On dingyou day, the household troops of the Prince of Jin at the capital were sent back to their commands.
s0077.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the household troops of the Prince of Jin at the capital were sent back to their commands.

s0078.literal: Nangjiatai brought troops to Jin Prefecture, held Baitu Pass; the Shaanxi branch secretariat supervised troops to resist them.
s0078.idiomatic: Nangjiatai brought troops to Jin Prefecture, held Baitu Pass; the Shaanxi branch secretariat supervised troops to resist them.

s0079.literal: The privy council said: "Nangjiatai, resisting with troops in Sichuan, his disorder is not yet ended; we request that Pacifier of the West Martial and Tranquil Prince Shishban and others all mobilize troops, with Huguang Branch Secretariat officials Tughuan, Biesie, Boluo, and Zheng Angxiao to command the army in advance to suppress him.
s0079.idiomatic: The privy council said: "Nangjiatai, resisting with troops in Sichuan, his disorder is not yet ended; we request that Pacifier of the West Martial and Tranquil Prince Shishban and others all mobilize troops, with Huguang Branch Secretariat officials Tughuan, Biesie, Boluo, and Zheng Angxiao to command the army in advance to suppress him.

s0081.literal: On wuxu day, Chaghan Na'ur pacification commissioner Satemish was ordered to lead the Mongol troops of his command, join Pacifier of the West Martial and Tranquil Prince and others, and suppress Sichuan.
s0081.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Chaghan Na'ur pacification commissioner Satemish was ordered to lead the Mongol troops of his command, join Pacifier of the West Martial and Tranquil Prince and others, and suppress Sichuan.

s0082.literal: For hired laborers — if the master committed abominable treason or harmed them personally, they were permitted to sue at court; for other matters not involving themselves, they were not permitted to inform or denounce — this was established as regulation.
s0082.idiomatic: For hired laborers — if the master committed abominable treason or harmed them personally, they were permitted to sue at court; for other matters not involving themselves, they were not permitted to inform or denounce — this was established as regulation.

s0083.literal: The 《Essentials of Agriculture and Sericulture》 and the 《Illustrations of Mulberry Planting》 were promulgated.
s0083.idiomatic: The 《Essentials of Agriculture and Sericulture》 and the 《Illustrations of Mulberry Planting》 were promulgated.

s0084.literal: On xinchou day, the central secretariat deliberated posthumously honoring the Emperor's mother Yiqilie as Empress Renxian Zhangsheng and Tangut as Empress Wenxian Zhaosheng; the relevant offices were ordered to prepare seals and regalia.
s0084.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the central secretariat deliberated posthumously honoring the Emperor's mother Yiqilie as Empress Renxian Zhangsheng and Tangut as Empress Wenxian Zhaosheng; the relevant offices were ordered to prepare seals and regalia.

s0085.literal: Buddhist rites were performed at the Tour of the Imperial City.
s0085.idiomatic: Buddhist rites were performed at the Tour of the Imperial City.

s0086.literal: Mengtongmengsuandian native official Asanmu of Yunnan Branch Secretariat, Kai'nan native official Aifang, Babao Xifu, Jinchi, ninety-nine caves, and Yinshaluo Circuits all came to present tribute goods.
s0086.idiomatic: Mengtongmengsuandian native official Asanmu of Yunnan Branch Secretariat, Kai'nan native official Aifang, Babao Xifu, Jinchi, 99 caves, and Yinshaluo Circuits all came to present tribute goods.

s0087.literal: On guimao day, gold and silver were granted in varying amounts to Prince Wu Munai, Prince of Xining Hudadi Shimi, Prince Nohaihan, and Kokochü.
s0087.idiomatic: On guimao day, gold and silver were granted in varying amounts to Prince Wu Munai, Prince of Xining Hudadi Shimi, Prince Nohaihan, and Kokochü.

s0088.literal: On bingwu day, Nangjiatai divided his troops to press on Xiangyang; the Huguang Branch Secretariat mobilized troops to garrison Bozhou and Guizhou.
s0088.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Nangjiatai divided his troops to press on Xiangyang; the Huguang Branch Secretariat mobilized troops to garrison Bozhou and Guizhou.

s0089.literal: On jiyou day, Mars encroached upon the Well asterism.
s0089.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Mars encroached upon the Well asterism.

s0090.literal: On xinhai day, the Emperor said to court officials: "Sadi has returned and reported that the Great Elder Brother has already ascended the imperial throne.
s0090.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Emperor said to court officials: "Sadi has returned and reported that the Great Elder Brother has already ascended the imperial throne.

s0091.literal: For all who were appointed before the twenty-first day of the second month, commission edicts should be issued promptly;
s0091.idiomatic: For all who were appointed before the 21st day of the second month, commission edicts should be issued promptly;

s0092.literal: for appointments hereafter through selection, they shall report to the traveling encampment.
s0092.idiomatic: for appointments hereafter through selection, they shall report to the traveling encampment.

s0093.literal: " An earthquake occurred in Hefei County, Luzhou Route.
s0093.idiomatic: " An earthquake occurred in Hefei County, Luzhou Route.

s0094.literal: On renzi day, the relevant offices were ordered to build traveling palace tents.
s0094.idiomatic: On renzi day, the relevant offices were ordered to build traveling palace tents.

s0095.literal: On guichou day, Prince Yolqi Temür and others reached Bozhou, summoning and instructing native officials who had followed Nangjiatai; Yang Yanlibuhua and his younger brothers all came to surrender.
s0095.idiomatic: On guichou day, Prince Yolqi Temür and others reached Bozhou, summoning and instructing native officials who had followed Nangjiatai; Yang Yanlibuhua and his younger brothers all came to surrender.

s0096.literal: On jiayin day, the Kui Zhang Pavilion Academy was established, rank 3a; Hanlin academician-director Qutlugh Durmish and Senior Grand Academician of the Academy of Gathered Worthies Zhao Shiyan were both made grand academicians; investigating censor Sadi and Hanlin direct academician Yu Ji were both made attendant-scribe academicians; conferral and presentation commissioners were also established, one each.
s0096.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Kui Zhang Pavilion Academy was established, rank 3a; Hanlin academician-director Qutlugh Durmish and Senior Grand Academician of the Academy of Gathered Worthies Zhao Shiyan were both made grand academicians; investigating censor Sadi and Hanlin direct academician Yu Ji were both made attendant-scribe academicians; conferral and presentation commissioners were also established, 1 each.

s0097.literal: Note blocks were recast, and the worn ones were still destroyed.
s0097.idiomatic: Note blocks were recast, and the worn ones were still destroyed.

s0098.literal: Troops from Henan, Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, and Shandong numbering eleven thousand, and two thousand from the Left and Right Wing Mongol guard armies, were mobilized to suppress Sichuan.
s0098.idiomatic: Troops from Henan, Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, and Shandong numbering 11,000, and 2,000 from the Left and Right Wing Mongol guard armies, were mobilized to suppress Sichuan.

s0099.literal: On yimao day, the Pacification Commission and Commander-in-Chief's Office of Yinshaluo Circuit and other places was established.
s0099.idiomatic: On yimao day, the Pacification Commission and Commander-in-Chief's Office of Yinshaluo Circuit and other places was established.

s0100.literal: On bingchen day, Lintong and Xianyang counties of Fengyuan and more than eight hundred Uighur households reported famine; the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, acting on exigent authority, issued thirteen thousand ingots of notes to relieve Xianyang, five thousand four hundred shi of wheat to relieve Lintong, and more than one hundred shi of wheat to relieve the Uighurs; envoys were dispatched to report, and it was approved.
s0100.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Lintong and Xianyang counties of Fengyuan and more than 800 Uighur households reported famine; the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, acting on exigent authority, issued 13,000 ingots of notes to relieve Xianyang, 5,400 shi of wheat to relieve Lintong, and more than 100 shi of wheat to relieve the Uighurs; envoys were dispatched to report, and it was approved.
